reason: Gain is about zero and it goes against the API-load cut. (1) The window is already small. Probe 51's '?' threshold is 12:14:57Z + 10.2 h = 22:26:57Z. The regular poller's phase (headers 15:41:53, 15:51:56, 16:01:59Z; period ~10:03) puts polls at ~22:23:53Z and ~22:33:56Z. Only a completion in (22:23:53, 22:26:57] (~3.1 min) is lost. A 3-min loop starting at 21:15Z has its own lost window of up to ~3.1 min (180 s sleep + call time), so it adds nothing unless the poller is restarted first. (2) Completion in that window is unlikely. exp85a (same base, no CI) had L in (7.01, 7.19] h, and the measured CI dL is 1.60-2.18 h, so exp87a should land at L ~8.6-9.4 h (21:00-21:40Z). L = 10.15-10.2 h is a >2-sd tail (K-family spread 6.87-7.81 h), P << 1%. EV ~ P(<1%) x P(51 reads '+'/'0u') x 0.001 public = ~1e-6, not 1e-4. (3) Even then the '?' is not spurious. L > 10.03 h is inside the 'ins-tail?' zone (9.6-10.2 h). exp89r stacks SEC + DIS 2.25 on top of exp87a, with a 10.75 h admission, so falling back to non-CI exp89q is the runtime-safe choice. (4) Cost and risk. The session cut API load at 15:57Z after a 'Resource abuse' ban reported elsewhere and told agents to minimise Kaggle calls. ListSubmissions has already returned 429 Too Many Requests (ledger, 2026-09-26 20:36:50Z). ~25 extra calls in 75 min triple the rate and could make the regular poller fail at the critical moment, which would cause the '?' this is meant to prevent. Also, two processes appending to poll.log at once can interleave blocks. No value on private, since the lever is public-only.
fix: Do not run the loop. If anything: after the ~22:23-22:24Z regular poll, and only if 56640366 is still PENDING, make ONE manual ListSubmissions call at ~22:26:00Z and append it as '=== <ts> [manual]' plus the CSV (1 call). Do not restart the poller between 21:00Z and 22:30Z, so the ~22:23:53Z phase is kept.
realistic_gain: ~0 (EV about 1e-6 public; about 0 private). The loop's lost window (<=3.1 min) equals the poller's current lost window (~3.1 min), and the risk is negative: 429s and more API load after the ban notice.
